paragraphs.text: Cullinarn was the master of the House of Oor-tael in Estark , on Dominaria , and the father of Garth One-eye . He was killed in the Night of Fire .

Cullinarn was tall, red-haired, with a beard and mustache cropped short. He wore long, flowing robes embroidered in rich blue and wore a circlet of turquoise stones upon his brow. He had a winter palace in the Southlands near Gish , where his son later lived.

In his youth, he had saved the life of his friend, Grand Master Kuthuman , from an assassin; he carried the marks of that poisoned dagger until his death. He resisted Kuthuman when the Master of Arena ordered Oor-tael to surrender its blue and green mana, fearing that Kuthuman would become a tyrant after his ascension . Zarel then convinced Kuthuman to ally with the other House Masters and storm the building of Oor-tael. Cullinarn was killed in the subsequent Night of Fire .
Cullinarn was a master of invisibility .
Due to a minor print error in Magic: The Gathering - Arena , where the first "l" in Cullinarn is not fully inked, some versions of the novel appear to have Hammen call him "Cuilinarn".
